about: docs/E2EE.md §5: meta age files to the content identity, with the fixed fileKey, eph and nonce of file (so all share file.head). valid: the exact blob for the text padded with spaces to paddedLength; decrypting it, checked per §5.3 against head and ciphertextSize, yields name and plaintextSize. invalid: blobs that decrypt (as age files) to text plus spaces up to paddedLength (textHex where the text isn't UTF-8) and fail §5.3 with result, given head and ciphertextSize.

invalid.why: headSha256 of the meta's own head
UTF-8-encoded surrogate ED A0 80 in name
byte order mark before the text
plaintext of 600 bytes (not a multiple of 512)
